title: Wizz Air A320 Missions & More! New MSFS 2024 Activities just dropped
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: New Microsoft Flight Simulator Activities and A320 Missions (Feb 22, 2026). Explore the latest MSFS Marketplace content for PC, featuring A320 Wizz Air and Aer Lingus flight packs!

This week’s must-have additions are packed with airliner action and unique exploration content for PC simmers.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – A320 WIZZ AIR (A320 missions for airline fans)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain – Aer Lingus (Fly classic Aer Lingus routes)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: History by Air – Battle of the Bulge (Historic wartime mission experience)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 1 (Discover unusual world locations)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 2 (More hidden gems around the world)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 3 (Expand your exploration journey)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 4 (Another set of eye‑catching destinations)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 5 (Newest pack with fresh unique spots)

If you enjoy these weekly breakdowns, don’t forget to hit the like button, subscribe for more MSFS content, and drop a comment sharing which activity you’ll try first!

Thanks for watching and supporting the channel. ✈️ See you in the skies!
